arguments.summary: Priya led the operations check-in on Thursday 12 November 2026, with Dana absent. The group agreed to go with the Elm Street site, with the lease letter to be drafted by 1 December. Whether the board or the executive director signs the lease was left open.

sections.heading: Elm Street site
points: Elm Street is the only one of the three options with a loading dock.
Marcus is comfortable with the rent if the Foundation grant comes through.
The group agreed to go with Elm Street.

sections.heading: Foundation budget
points: Marcus has the revised budget numbers, and the Foundation wants them by 20 November.

sections.heading: Hamper drive
points: About ten more volunteers are needed for the hamper drive.
Li Wei will put out a call and recruit them over the next two weeks.
Samuel Cho will run the raffle again this year.

sections.heading: Zoning
points: Gabe confirmed Elm Street is zoned for warehouse use.
Gabe will email the zoning letter this week.

sections.heading: Lease signing
points: Whether the board or the executive director signs the lease is unsettled, pending a bylaws check.

sections.heading: Walk-in freezer
points: The walk-in freezer warranty expires soon, and nobody has checked what it covers.
The switch to Northern Cold as freezer supplier was approved last month and is done.

arguments.text: Go with the Elm Street site for the second distribution site (rent works if the Foundation grant comes through).
